introduction: Softcodes is the premiere autonomous coding agent. Get ready to architect, code, debug, and boost your productivity like you've never seen before. To continue, Softcodes requires an API key.
notice: To get started, this extension needs an API provider.

productivityFeatures.sectionTitle: Made for how your team actually works.
productivityFeatures.sectionSubtitle: From fast-moving startups to structured enterprises, Softcodes adapts to your team’s real-world workflows — not the other way around.

organize.title: Stay organized, effortlessly.
organize.body: Easily track tasks, assignees, and statuses in one place.

collaborate.title: Built for fast-moving teams.
collaborate.body: Collaborate in real time with live edits and comments.

portfolio.title: Precision-driven portfolio growth.
portfolio.body: View tasks as lists, boards, calendars, or timelines.

ai.title: AI-assisted orchestration.
ai.body: Let Softcodes suggest assignments, priorities, and deadlines.

telemetry.title: Help Improve Softcodes
telemetry.anonymousTelemetry: Send error and usage data to help us fix bugs and improve the extension. No code, prompts, or personal information is ever sent.
telemetry.changeSettings: You can always change this at the bottom of the <settingsLink>settings</settingsLink>
